Claude Fable 5.2 is available on paid, non-trial plans as rollout reaches your organization, with Low, Medium, High, XHigh, and Max reasoning levels, Fast Mode variants of each, and as a Fusion lead. Token pricing is \$8 per million input tokens, \$40 per million output tokens, \$0.20 per million cache reads, and \$10 per million cache writes. Fast Mode costs twice the standard price. Legacy credit-based enterprise pricing matches Fable 5.1; the launch gift badge through November 23, 2026 at 18:30 UTC does not indicate a discount. On both token-based plans, GPT-5.6 Sol's standard-context rates change on November 21, 2026 at 07:00 UTC from \$4 to \$5 per million input tokens and from \$20 to \$30 per million output tokens. Fast mode costs twice those rates. > [!NOTE] > > **Voice mode call pricing:** A live [Voice mode call](https://docs.devin.ai/work-with-devin/voice-mode.md) uses a separate agent model from the model selected for the session. Agent model usage during the call consumes quota or ACUs as applicable and does not receive model-specific promotions, including free or discounted SWE-2 usage. The live audio connection itself is not separately charged. Recorded voice prompts are different: transcription does not consume quota or ACUs, and submitted prompts are billed like typed prompts under the selected session model. # SWE-2, swe-grep, swe-check Our SWE model family of in-house frontier models are built specifically for software engineering tasks. SWE-2 and SWE-2 Flash each come in Medium, High, and Max reasoning-effort variants. Our in-house models include: * `SWE-2 Flash`: Available in Devin Desktop and Devin CLI, not in Devin cloud. Free plans can select Medium; High and Max require a paid plan. * `SWE-2`: Cognition's software engineering model, available in Medium, High, and Max reasoning effort. * `SWE-1.7`: Our previous flagship software engineering model. * `SWE-1.6`: Our previous-generation model built for software engineering agents, optimized for both intelligence and model UX. Read our [research announcement](https://cognition.com/blog/swe-1-6). * `SWE-1-mini`: Powers passive suggestions in [Tab](https://docs.devin.ai/desktop/tab/overview.md), optimized for real-time latency. * `swe-grep`: Powers context retrieval and [Fast Context](https://docs.devin.ai/desktop/context-awareness/fast-context.md) * `swe-check`: Powers [Quick Review](https://docs.devin.ai/desktop/quick-review.md) with fast, lightweight reviews optimized for common code issues. > [!TIP] > > To get the models and prices for your own account programmatically, use the [List Models API](https://docs.devin.ai/desktop/accounts/api-reference/list-models.md). Admins can change which models the team allows with the [Update Model Allowlist API](https://docs.devin.ai/desktop/accounts/api-reference/update-models.md). This documentation is built and hosted on [Mintlify](https://mintlify.com), a developer documentation platform.
